methods.label: Take logarithms and factor
methods.explanation:
The logarithm requires \(x>0\). On this domain both sides are positive, so taking base-ten logarithms is valid and reversible. This turns the variable exponent into a product:
\[
(\log_{10}x)^2=3\log_{10}x-2.
\]
Let \(t=\log_{10}x\). Then
\[
t^2-3t+2=(t-1)(t-2)=0,
\]
so \(t=1\) or \(t=2\). Since \(x=10^t\), the only candidates are \(x=10\) and \(x=100\).

Substitution into the original equation gives \(10=10\) and \(10000=10000\), respectively. Thus the solution set is \(\{10,100\}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
